name: Neon and Databricks Startup Credits
free_limit: Self-funded early-stage startups can receive up to $1,000 in Neon credits; eligible VC/accelerator-backed startups may receive up to $200,000 in credits jointly across Neon and Databricks, valid for 12 months after acceptance.
watch_out: The $200,000 figure is a combined Neon + Databricks maximum, NOT a guaranteed $200,000 solely for Neon. Funded applicants generally need at least $1 million raised or participation in a recognized accelerator; acceptance and individual award vary. Normal paid usage continues after credit expiry/exhaustion. Card requirement is not explicitly confirmed.
